about: Overrides for the single successor republish.py names when it tombstones a split row of supersede-map.json. A tombstone carries one replaced_by_iri, so each of the 18 split rows needs one entry point; every other successor of the row stays published and reachable from it.

default_rule.material: A v1 'material lot' was a coated electrode batch. Its successor is the electrode spec its v5 discs instance (the batch as a unit), not one of the discs. Ruling default of decision 10 in the close-out plan, not yet confirmed by the owner.
default_rule.cell_spec: A v1 cell spec that covered two electrode designs names the v5 cell spec whose working electrode batch label sorts first (natural sort: AQ before NMP, lower batch number first). Gives LNMO-AQ-1, LNMO-AQ-2 and SiGr-AQ-2.
default_rule.material_spec: Same rule as cell_spec, over the electrode specs: the one whose batch label sorts first. A v1 material spec therefore points at the electrode design its cell spec points at.

overrides_help: Map a published_id of a split row to the successor IRI you want instead, e.g. {"https://w3id.org/battinfo/spec/dyb1-7smn-efq9-tnqf": "https://w3id.org/battinfo/spec/whvd-e6g6-zd72-n9f4"}. The successor must be one of the row's successors, or for a material row the electrode spec of its discs. Preflight refuses anything else.
extra_supersedes_help: Rows outside supersede-map.json, as {"published_id", "resource_type", "successor"}. Candidate, deliberately not enabled: the Battery Knowledge Graph stub organization/j50f-3ebx-sssw-svnm (Haldor Topsoe) -> organization/vz1v-rvhz-n77h-344c, per the curator ruling of 2026-08-21 recorded in the Topsoe record's editorial note. Add it here once the owner confirms; it is not part of the Flores corpus map.
